Hero.Title: Consolidated reporting
Hero.Description: One view across your entire wealth, independent of any bank. We bring your bank accounts, custodians, real estate, private equity holdings and collectibles into clear, regular reporting.

Intro: Your wealth is spread across several banks, managers and jurisdictions. Each statement has its own format, currency and calendar. Consolidated reporting brings these sources into a single, current and verifiable view.
We produce independent performance and fee reporting. You see what you hold, how it is moving and what it costs, without relying on any single institution's reporting.

Pillars.Title: One view
Pillars.Body: Banks, custodians, real estate, private equity and collectibles brought together in one dashboard, in your reference currency.

Pillars.Title: Independence
Pillars.Body: Our reporting is independent of any bank. Figures are reconciled against each counterparty's official statements.

Pillars.Title: Measured performance
Pillars.Body: Time-weighted return (TWR) reporting, comparison against benchmarks and a clear reading of contributions.

Pillars.Title: Fee transparency
Pillars.Body: Identification and reading of explicit and implicit fees, for a full understanding of what your banking relationships cost.

Closing.Title: Reporting on your rhythm
Closing.Body: Monthly, quarterly or on demand, your reporting is structured around your priorities and shared securely with the people you designate.

Perimeter: Execution, custody and asset management remain with your chosen regulated banks and asset managers. Ridger provides consolidation, reporting, coordination and administrative oversight. Ridger does not manage assets and does not provide investment advice.
